reviews.title: Getting there is everything. Cheapest airline in Thai Market
reviews.text: Since 2020, I flew Thai Lion Air to many destinations as I have to travel up country on monthly basis. From Donmuang to Chiangmai, Chiangrai, Hat Yai, Khonkaen, Udon Thani, Ubon Ratchatani. To make it very precise and concise, Thai Lion Air is the cheapest airline in the market. If your objective is to getting to your destination at the cheapest price possible, Lion Air is your best choice. But you have to bare in mind that the legroom is horrible. For 5'10 height like myself, my knee always hit the front seat. Seat is far from comfortable. No inflight entertainment whatsoever (unless you see flight attendant security demonstration as an entertainment then that is only entertainment you can get on board), no service, cleanliness is average at best, seat can be shaken depend on the aircraft age, check in and boarding is taking long queue, no assistant at the Don Muang Airport- prepare for 40 minutes security check, No food on board (unless you make prior purchase). So, the airline is really serve the objective of low cost airline. Getting you from A to B. But their price is very thrilling even among the low cost, Thai Lion Air is still a real deal. Now my piece of advice to travelers, Thai Lion Air saw every seat can make extra income. So, the seat on Row1-5 and the wing exit will cost money for extra legroom. My piece of advice, BUY IT. The cost is very cheap from 150 to 300 Thai Baht (roughly US$5-10). It worth much more. You will get priority boarding. You will get decent leg room that you no longer need to be cramp down in your seat.
reviews.author: Chakrit T

reviews.title: Thai Lion Air - Changed dates after booking
reviews.text: Thai Lion Air - Flight changed one Day - hopeless customer service We had booked a return flight, Bangkok - Kathmandu and booked / paid for accommodation and two treks on booking the flight for mid April 2023. Now mid March 2023, received standard email 'has been reschedule to a new flight details as below' - the following day . After having to telephone customer service, (+66) 2-529-9999 from New Zealand and waiting 48 minutes, finally got an operator. 'English please". Response - ''Call later' - and promptly hung up. Emails to INFO@LIONAIRTHAI.COM remain unanswered. As we were given more than 15 days notice, according to the website, there will be no compensation. Emails were not responded to. The customer service is only in Thai. Finally was able to get a travel agent in New Zealand, told us how to get English speaking customer service through Thai Lion Air. With the changed dates, or trekking in Nepal is very difficult. We will lose a lot of money, as we booked the flights, then booked hotels in Bangkok, Kathmandu and our hiking. Finally customer services for Thai Lion air said they would refund. BUT on Trip advisor, many customers have complained that they didn't get the refunds without lots of hassle. So, we would never book Thai Lion Air.

reviews.title: Baggage restrictions - worth checking
reviews.text: Keep an eye on baggage restrictions! I bought a multileg ticket from Skyscanner and only saw when I got the ticket the checked baggage restriction is 10kg. You also get 7kg carry on with small dimensions so if you can work around that fine, but I had arrived in Bangkok after a Vietnam to Cambodia bike ride and on a 3 week trip so needed more baggage (all my other flights were 20kg). I tried adding baggage to my booking on their website but unable to because I didn’t book with the airline. Calling, social media and emailing was pointless too as months later no response. I found arriving extra early to the airport (5.15am for a 9.55am flight) I was able to go to the Thai Lion sales desk with no queue and buy an extra 5kg for just 150 baht (around 3 GBP/ 4 USD). Very easy. I would recommend if you are likely to be over and can’t buy extra online get to the airport 4 hours ahead of your flight for a discounted rate and save on extortionate excess baggage fees!

reviews.title: Horrible!!!!
reviews.text: I will never ever ever travel with this airline again. It was so horrible and senseless - it is just ridiculous. The ground hostess wouldn’t tell us our seats. We wanted to know if we were sitting together for separate and she said she can’t and won’t tell us. Imagine that 😂 Apart from having a baggage allowance of 7kgs in our hand carry, which makes sense - the fact that they even check the weight again at the gate makes zero sense because the scale is different. They strictly say 7kgs but if your luggage at the check in counter was 7 and if you don’t use the same scale, the chance of it being 7.2 or 7.3 whatever is obviously expected. They just wouldn’t let us board until I took out the 0.3kgs from my handcarry and put it in my handbag lol. I mean that same item is going to be in my handbag going in the same aircraft and which was already approved during check in time. It was a chaotic mess when we were boarding because of 0.3kgs, 0.2 kgs - we were four girls traveling together. Then they don’t serve free water because it is a budget airline which is fine but they only accept Thai Baht and don’t have a card machine if you don’t have that currency on you. If you talk back asking questions, they threaten to file a report against you by showing you a form saying if we continue we will be thrown out. Which is fine if I was rude in the first place but like this passenger was so thirsty and he was desperate and the air hostess just wouldn’t budge and was soooo rude. Eventually the passenger also got a little rude and she threw that form on this face. And it gets better, you can’t eat outside food on the plane. Yes, I am serious. No outside food. We were having cupcakes which we bought from the airport and they stopped us 😂 Never again. Never ever. This airline is a joke and the ground and air host and hostesses aren’t logical at all. They are rude and just overall the rules make no sense at all. Like zero sense - nada! Pay 5,000rs more for a logical airline - I can’t believe I’m using the word logic here but wow this airline made no sense to me. I guess I should just be happy it didn’t crash and I’m alive 🙈
